items.quote: He then rebuilt towns near Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines.
items.contrast: The rebuilt towns were near Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines, whereas Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod were places whose walls he broke down.
items.reason: The window directly and uniquely identifies where he rebuilt towns. The question tests whether the reader distinguishes the rebuilding locations from the cities attacked in the preceding sentence.
